grade_policy: PASS/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW are mutually exclusive model grades. A complete PDP Specs inventory without an ENERGY STAR certification field is NOT_APPLICABLE and does not create LOW; LOW requires an explicit No on an existing certification field or another confirmed missing applicable publication point. Refrigerator, TV, and Tablet detail assessments were recalculated from complete source inventories. Remaining Washer LOWs arise from annual-energy findings; Range, Monitor, and Computer LOWs retain confirmed missing logo points. Refrigerator NO_FINDING records are included in PASS. TV annual-energy comparison is out of scope. Tablet EPA identity uses exact equality against explicit model_number or additional_model_information tokens; no prefix/fuzzy matching. Printed EnergyGuide/PDP model identity accepts a matching fixed prefix despite trailing-star and remaining-suffix length differences; EPA Current registration uses separate source matching.
